roles.role: Targeted-sequencing allele-specific copy-number segments from capture-region SNPs identified with normal samples, allele counts, logR and BAF.
roles.qualification: Requires capture BED, normal-panel SNP selection, allele counting, sequencing preparation, correction, segmentation and complete model/QC. A highly homozygous case was excluded by the authors; the numerical component does not reproduce this decision.

roles.role: ASCAT 2.5.2 is a somatic copy-number comparator on short-read GRCh37 tumor/cell-line data and 500 simulated genomes. Benchmarking assesses same-strand breakends within 10 kb and total/allelic copy-number RMSE across 10-kb bins.
roles.qualification: JaBbA performance is not attributed to ASCAT. Supplementary Notes 3 and 6 remain required for the full recipe; retrieval failed. Legacy full segmentation under the installed R 4.6.2 failed and is not admitted.
